record.scope: The two units in appliesTo declare MAGNET_RISE: Nosepass (1 star) and Probopass (2 stars); both maxPP 100, range 2, no passive. The strategy is shared; unit differences are only the star count (table index).
record.summary: Self and adjacent-ally buff; deals no damage. The strategy keeps the default requiresTarget = true (the caster must have a target to cast; the target is not otherwise used). It takes the caster's adjacent cells, keeps occupants of the caster's team, sorts them by current HP ascending, keeps the first 2 / 4 / 6 / 8 (by stars; Nosepass 2, Probopass 4), then adds the caster itself. Each of these units gets PROTECT for 2000 ms (not stackable, not granted to an enraged unit) and a dodge increase of 0.1 / 0.1 / 0.1 / 0.2 (requested, by stars; i.e. 10 percentage points for both units), scaled by the caster's AP and crit if the cast crit, adjusted by the receiver's Big Eater Belt, added to the receiver's existing dodge and capped at 0.9. The dodge increase has no timer in addDodgeChance. A protected unit takes no damage and no heal while PROTECT lasts.

targeting.who: the caster plus up to N allied units in the 8 cells adjacent to the caster, chosen by lowest current HP
targeting.note: requiresTarget is not overridden, so the base default true applies: the unit needs a target to cast (it walks to range as usual). The strategy never reads target besides passing it to super.process and does not cast on it. Allies, not enemies, are selected; the number N (2 for Nosepass, 4 for Probopass) caps adjacent allies, and the caster is added on top of N.

geometry.shape: the caster's 8 adjacent cells (clipped to the board), ranked by current HP; at most N allies of them are affected

effects.target: each selected ally and the caster
effects.scaling: none; fixed 2000 ms, not scaled by AP
effects.resolution: triggerProtect(2000): does nothing if the unit already has protect (the old cooldown stays) or is enraged; otherwise sets protect and protectCooldown = 2000. updateProtect ticks it. Entering rage clears protect. While protected: attacks against it are not successful and deal 0, handleDamage and handleSpecialDamage return takenDamage 0 and no death, and handleHeal does nothing.

effects.target: each selected ally and the caster
effects.scaling: requested = table value. Applied by addDodgeChance (apBoost 1): requested x (1 + caster AP/100) x (caster critPower if the cast crit), then the receiver's Big Eater Belt (x1.25, rounded down to 3 digits) and Twist Band (unchanged for a positive value); added to the receiver's existing dodge and capped at 0.9 in total. Crit is rolled by castAbility only if the caster has ABILITY_CRIT (canCritByDefault is false).
effects.resolution: requested (table) -> applied (after AP, crit, belt) -> new total dodge (capped at 0.9). The 'dodge' stat is a probability of avoiding an attack; the dodge roll is skipped against attackers with Xray Vision or LOCK_ON and while the target is paralysed, asleep, frozen or locked. No expiry is coded in addDodgeChance.
slice of the HP-sorted adjacent allies; the caster is additionally buffed (so Nosepass buffs up to 3 units including itself, Probopass up to 5). Fewer adjacent allies than N means all of them.

statusEffects.effect: PROTECT 2000 ms on the caster and each selected ally (skipped on units already protected or enraged)

buffs.applied: after AP, crit, Big Eater Belt and the 0.9 cap

starBehavior.note: the protect duration is the same at every star count; only the number of adjacent allies grows (2/4/6/8) and the dodge rises at 4 stars (0.2), which neither unit reaches at its factory star count. Whether other mechanics change an entity's star count was not examined.

record.positionalConditions: Only the caster's 8 adjacent cells are considered (allies elsewhere are never affected). With no adjacent ally only the caster is buffed. Selection is by lowest current HP, not distance.
record.repeatedCastsAndModes: No stored mode. Recasting adds the dodge value again (cumulative up to the 0.9 cap) because no expiry is coded; PROTECT is refreshed only when the unit is not currently protected.
record.rawVsResolved: Declared raw: PROTECT 2000 ms, dodge 0.1 (Nosepass and Probopass), 2 / 4 adjacent allies. Dodge requested 0.1 = applied only after x(1 + AP/100) x crit factor, the receiver's Big Eater Belt x1.25 (rounded down to 3 digits) and the 0.9 total cap; a unit that is already protected or enraged does not get a new PROTECT, but still receives the dodge. Protect is not an amount, so no requested/applied split exists for it.
